name: Weather Visualizer
description: A picture of the weather where the device is, drawn by an AI image model from a prompt that talks about it ({temp}, {condition}, {daypart}...). A text model can rewrite the prompt first. The weather is the device's weather provider's (OpenWeatherMap: its key and units); the text and the picture are the Generated Image's parts, chosen separately.

properties.name: weatherPrompt
properties.default: A bold, flat-color illustration of {place} at {daypart} in {season}: {condition}, {temp}.
properties.title: Prompt
properties.description: What to draw. The fields below stand for the weather where the device is; one that is not known drops out of the prompt.

properties.name: randomizePrompt
properties.title: Rewrite the Prompt
properties.description: Have a text model rewrite the prompt (the weather included) before each picture, so no two are alike. It costs one more request.
